zh: 每个字母在键盘上的位置唯一，手指当前位置又由上一个输入的字母确定，所以每一步的移动量是确定的。
先建立字母到下标的映射，再顺着单词累加相邻两次位置之差的绝对值，起点是下标 0。
用长度 26 的数组记录每个字母的下标。current 初始为 0，遍历 word，每个字符把 |pos[c]−current| 加到答案上并把 current 更新为 pos[c]，最后输出总和。
en: Each letter has a unique key position and the finger's position is fixed by the previous letter, so every move is determined.
Map each letter to its index first, then walk the word adding the absolute difference between consecutive positions, starting from index 0.
Store each letter's index in an array of 26. Set current to 0; for each character of word add |pos[c]−current| to the answer and set current to pos[c]. Print the total.

explanationEn:
## Idea

Precompute the position of every letter and add up the distance from the previous position for each character in turn.

## Correctness

Each character's target position is unique and the current finger position is fixed by the previous character, so every necessary move is exactly the difference of the two positions; their sum is the total time.

## Complexity

O(26+n) time, O(26) space.
